printed.description: Everything printed for this entry, transcribed in reading order: labels, variable assignments ('R = Me'), each result with the protocol label and footnote markers printed with it, conditions printed with it

results.description: Each result printed for this entry, verbatim with what identifies it: '[in situ] [Fe] 71%', '78% b', 'n.d.', '3:1 d.r.'. Empty when the entry prints none

reasoning.description: How many reactions (experiments) this entry reports and why: which results come from the same reactants under the same conditions (one reaction, several measurements) and which differ in a reactant, a condition or the protocol

label.description: Label of the compound or entry this reaction is reported under

results.description: Numbers of this reaction's results in `results` (1 = first)

variant.description: Key of the template variant (protocol) this reaction was run under; null when it comes under no protocol label

footnote_markers.description: Markers printed on this reaction's label or results

variables.description: Variable groups printed as text for this reaction ('R = Me', 'X = Cl')

drawn_structures.description: Catalysts, ligands, additives drawn only inside this entry that an override refers to; their boxes are taken later. Usually empty

overrides.description: How this reaction differs from the template and its variant, as printed in this entry: row cells, a condition printed with it, the alternative it uses, the value of each per-entry condition

rows.description: One row per reaction reported in this entry

issues.description: Doubts a reviewer should look at

key.description: Key of the template participant/condition to change, or a new key for action=add

action.description: use: of the alternatives of an `alternative_groups` entry, this one applies (the others of its group drop out)

role.description: New role. Required for action=add (a condition role). For replace, set it only to change a participant's role (e.g. to intermediate); else null

structure_key.description: Key of the drawn structure (`structures`) this refers to; null if it is not drawn

step.description: Number of the step (template.steps) this condition belongs to; null for a single-step reaction

structure_key.description: Key of the drawn structure (`structures`) this refers to; null if it is not drawn

alternatives.description: The options when the source says 'A or B' without saying which one was used here (at least two); empty when the item is definite

basis.description: Where this change is stated, e.g. 'footnote b', 'row cell: additive'; for an inferred change, the reasoning

stated_at.description: Where the paper states this when the block itself (its scheme, table, caption, footnotes) does not print it: document and page of the passage. Null when the block prints it, and for an inferred item

inferred.description: False for a change the paper states. True when it is your own conclusion (by analogy with another protocol, from chemical knowledge); `basis` then gives the reasoning

key.description: Printed label of the drawn compound (C1, L3) or a short slug

bbox.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] in PDF points
